dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of low-intensity dark islands concentrated along the dorsal midline, transitioning to smaller and more isolated dark clusters toward the posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the primary dark patches form a network of irregular polygons, predominantly triangles and quadrilaterals, spanning the mid-dorsal and lateral sections.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent and continuous lattice of high-intensity light lines creates a reticulated, map-like pattern that encloses the darker island structures across the entire visible surface.
